questions.description: Do you have a specific target quit date in mind, or are you looking to figure that out as part of the plan?
questions.title: When do you want to quit by?

questions.description: Knowing your current usage helps determine the right approach — quitting cold turkey vs. gradual reduction.
questions.title: How many cigarettes do you smoke per day?

questions.description: The duration of the habit affects both the physical dependency level and the approach to quitting.
questions.title: How long have you been smoking?

questions.description: If so, what happened? Understanding past attempts helps identify what worked and what didn't.
questions.title: Have you tried to quit before?

questions.description: Common triggers include stress, social situations, after meals, boredom, or alcohol. Identifying yours is key to building a coping strategy.
questions.title: What is your biggest trigger for smoking?

questions.description: This includes options like nicotine patches, gum, prescription medication, or vaping as a step-down. Some people prefer to go completely unaided.
questions.title: Are you open to using quitting aids?

questions.description: This could include speaking to a doctor, joining a stop-smoking programme, or working with a therapist or counsellor.
questions.title: Do you want professional support as part of your plan?

gold.taskDescription: Help the user create a concrete, personalised plan to stop smoking.
